rationale: The plan matches the reference on the essentials: VST input rather than raw counts, a signed WGCNA network, power chosen at scale-free fit 0.8 with the fit and mean connectivity reported, TOM with dynamic tree cut (min 30) and eigengene merge at 0.25, eigengene-vs-binary-trait correlation with BH across modules, and ORA against Hallmark/WikiPathways with the network genes as the explicit universe. It falls short by building the network on all filterByExpr-retained genes rather than the top ~5000 variable genes, by ranking hubs on kME alone without gene significance, by flagging but not stating a removal policy for an outlier sample, and by not stating a gene-set size window. The QC and report sections are otherwise specific to this 120-sample single-batch design and well documented.
